'''The Queen's Lance''' is an inn in the town of [[Kayacun]] in [[Saldaea]].

==Activities==
[[Weilin Aldragoran]] deals in jewels with [[Pavil Geraneos]] and [[Jeorg Damentanis]] at The Queen's Lance. After his business is concluded, [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] talks to him regarding a summons to ride to [[Tarwin's Gap]] with [[Lan Mandragoran]].{{ref/book|11|20}}
